title: "Measurement distributions and variability"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Each participant-variable bucket with a non-missing mean counts as **one
measurement**, whether it contains one or five observations. Missing means are
excluded; GPS coordinates are included. Reader date defaults apply when loading.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
triggerR <- new.env()
source("R/read_data.R", local = triggerR)
if (!exists("trigger_5min")) trigger_5min <- triggerR$read_trigger_5min()
trigger_5min <- triggerR$drop_suspect(trigger_5min)
```

```{r}
counts <- trigger_5min %>%
  select(origin, userId, bucket_5min, variable, mean) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean)) %>%
  distinct(origin, userId, bucket_5min, variable) %>%
  count(origin, variable, name = "buckets")
```

## Total by variable

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 9
p_n <- counts %>%
  ggplot(aes(buckets, reorder(variable, buckets))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2878A5") +
  facet_grid(origin ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M")) +
  labs(x = "Observed five-minute buckets", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
p_n
```

## Overview: original scale

All participants and dates are pooled. Each histogram uses the five-minute means,
with one contribution per observed bucket and no weighting by `n`. Axes vary by
variable; values retain their original units. No outlier thresholds are applied.

```{r}
plot_values <- function(source, variables = NULL, log = FALSE, binwidth = NULL) {
  p <- trigger_5min %>%
    select(origin, userId, bucket_5min, variable, mean) %>%
    filter(origin == source, !is.na(mean)) %>%
    filter(is.null(.env$variables) | variable %in% .env$variables) %>%
    distinct(origin, userId, bucket_5min, variable, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    ggplot(aes(mean)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 40, binwidth = binwidth, fill = "#2878A5") +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, ncol = 3, scales = "free") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
    labs(x = "Five-minute mean (original units)", y = "Observed buckets") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
  if (log) p <- p + scale_x_continuous(trans = "log1p", breaks = c(0, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000),
    labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
    labs(x = "Five-minute mean (log(1 + x) scale; original values)")
  p
}
```

## Focused views

### Log scale

`uvb`, `light`, `pm*` and `pc*`: log(1 + x) scale, retaining zeros and extremes.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
p_log <- plot_values("myair",
                     c("uvb", "light", "pm1", "pm25",
                       "pm10", "pc03", "pc05",
                       "pc1", "pc25", "pc5", "pc10"),
                     log = TRUE)
p_log
```

### Blood pressure

1 mmHg bins, retaining the full range.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 3
p_bp <- plot_values("smartwatchlow", c("bphigh", "bplow"), binwidth = 1)
p_bp
```

## Changes between consecutive buckets

`delta` is the current mean minus the previous mean for the same participant,
source and variable. Only pairs exactly five minutes apart are included; missing
means and longer gaps are excluded. Absolute changes describe transition size,
in each variable's original units, and cannot be ranked directly across units.

```{r}
changes <- trigger_5min %>%
  select(origin, userId, variable, bucket_5min, mean) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean)) %>%
  group_by(origin, userId, variable) %>%
  arrange(bucket_5min, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(delta = mean - lag(mean),
         gap = as.numeric(difftime(bucket_5min, lag(bucket_5min), units = "mins"))) %>%
  filter(gap == 5) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(origin, variable, delta)
```

```{r}
changes %>%
  group_by(origin, variable) %>%
  summarise(pairs = n(),
            median_abs = median(abs(delta)),
            p95_abs = quantile(abs(delta), 0.95),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 16
p_diff <- ggplot(changes, aes(abs(delta))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#2878A5") +
  facet_wrap(~ origin + variable, ncol = 3, scales = "free") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
  labs(x = "Absolute change between consecutive five-minute means", y = "Consecutive pairs") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
p_diff
```

## Hourly difference

`max - min` within each participant-variable hour, in original units.
Missing pairs are excluded; no minimum coverage threshold is applied.

```{r}
if (!exists("trigger_hourly")) trigger_hourly <- triggerR$read_trigger_hourly()

diff_h <- trigger_hourly %>%
  filter(!is.na(min), !is.na(max)) %>%
  transmute(origin, userId, hour_ts, variable, delta = max - min)

diff_h %>%
  group_by(origin, variable) %>%
  summarise(hours = n(), median = median(delta), p95 = quantile(delta, 0.95), .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 16
p_h <- ggplot(diff_h, aes(delta)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#2878A5") +
  facet_wrap(~ origin + variable, ncol = 3, scales = "free") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
  labs(x = "Hourly max - min (original units)", y = "Participant-hours") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
p_h
```

## Daily difference

`max - min` within each participant-variable day. Minimum and maximum are paired
by source, participant, date and variable. Sleep and missing pairs are excluded;
no minimum coverage threshold is applied. Daily and hourly differences describe
ranges within different window lengths, not transitions between windows.

```{r}
if (!exists("trigger_daily")) trigger_daily <- triggerR$read_trigger_daily()

diff_d <- trigger_daily %>%
  filter(statistic %in% c("min", "max")) %>%
  select(origin, userId, date, variable, statistic, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = statistic, values_from = value) %>%
  filter(!is.na(min), !is.na(max)) %>%
  transmute(origin, userId, date, variable, delta = max - min)

diff_d %>%
  group_by(origin, variable) %>%
  summarise(days = n(), median = median(delta), p95 = quantile(delta, 0.95), .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 16
p_d <- ggplot(diff_d, aes(delta)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#2878A5") +
  facet_wrap(~ origin + variable, ncol = 3, scales = "free") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
  labs(x = "Daily max - min (original units)", y = "Participant-days") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
p_d
```
